_pattern: CLEAR SIGNAL — concrete release with benchmarks + breaking changes

article.title: Pydantic v3 released: 5x validation speedup via Rust core rewrite
article.content: Replaces validation internals with a Rust engine. 5x faster on nested models. Breaking changes to model_validator. Migration guide included.

note: Real release, measurable benchmark, breaking changes that affect teams. List the domains that genuinely apply (1-3): libraries, python, open_source all fit.

_pattern: CLEAR NOISE — engagement-bait thought leadership, no substance

article.title: Why every developer needs to embrace AI or get left behind
article.content: The world is changing fast. Here are five mindset shifts you need today.

note: Your one-glance-adds-value test fails. No tool, technique, data, or change. domain is null when noise.

article.title: PydanticAI adds durable agent execution and resumable workflows
article.content: Adds persisted runs, resumable tool calls, and retry controls for long-running agents.

note: Concrete capability change for agent builders.

_pattern: BORDERLINE — funding with thin technical detail (kept as signal, low band)

article.title: Acme raises $12M Series A for AI-powered sales automation
article.content: Acme announced a Series A led by Sequoia. CEO is ex-Google.

note: Close call. Funding with SOME context = weak signal, not noise. If it were pure 'company X exists, raised money, no detail' I'd flag noise. This is the kind of edge to write a note on.

article.title: We're hiring a Senior ML Engineer
article.content: Join our growing team. Competitive salary, remote-first, great culture.

note: Hiring post, no technical substance about the system or stack.

_pattern: BORDERLINE — trend roundup (signal ONLY if it cites concrete data)

article.title: The State of AI Engineering 2026: five trends
article.content: Survey of 1,200 teams: 68% now run evals in CI, RAG adoption down 12% as context windows grow, agent frameworks consolidating around three players.

note: Kept as signal because it cites concrete numbers a practitioner would act on. If it were vague vibes ('AI is transforming everything') with no data, it's noise. The data is the dividing line.
